human_name: Y chromosome palindrome P5 (AZFb, P5/proximal-P1 NAHR substrate)

GRCh38.note: Approximate — Rhie 2023 states P4-P8 concordant between GRCh38-Y and T2T-Y. Coordinate match expected ~ ±200 kb.

CHM13.note: T2T-CHM13 v2.0/Y v1 — P5-left-arm 18362332-18857802 (495470 bp), P5-right-arm 18861260-19356680 (495420 bp), spacer 18857802-18861260 (~3.5 kb). Source: chm13v2.0Y_inverted_repeats_v1.bed (marbl).

architecture_note: P5 proximal arm is the upstream NAHR substrate for AZFb (P5/proximal-P1) deletions per Repping 2002. The ~6.2 Mb AZFb deletion removes everything between P5-proximal-arm and P1-proximal-arm (P5-P4-P3-P2-P1-proximal), causing meiotic arrest. P5 has the smallest spacer (~3.5 kb) of P1-P5.

clinical_deletion_products.name: P5/proximal-P1 deletion (AZFb)
clinical_deletion_products.mechanism: NAHR between P5 proximal arm and 92 kb block in P1.2 (Repping 2002)

primary.note: Identity 99.98% — mm=1. Spacer is tiny (~3.5 kb) so flanking anchor (P4 distal / P5 distal-flank) is critical.

fallback_chain.name: flanking_anchor
fallback_chain.trigger: primary returns ambiguous chains across both arms
fallback_chain.rationale: P5 spacer too small to anchor most reads; rely on P4-adjacent or X-degenerate-flank unique sequence

fallback_chain.name: azfb_deletion_check
fallback_chain.rationale: if P5-proximal-arm sequence is fused to P1 chain, flag as P5/proximal-P1 NAHR product

primary_sources.note: Skaletsky H et al., Nature. Table 3: P5 arm 496 kb, spacer 3.5 kb, identity 99.98%, total 996 kb.
Repping S et al., AJHG. P5/proximal-P1 NAHR — defining AZFb deletion mechanism.
Rozen S et al., Nature. Gene conversion in P5 arms.
Rhie A et al., Nature. P4-P8 concordant between GRCh38-Y and T2T-Y. CHM13-Y/v1 contained an inversion error at P5 boundary; corrected in v2.
